initialization: deterministic beam16 H5 seed from the current codebook and GT; no historical labels or books are required
primary_objective: sum of rolling 5/10-step SE(2) endpoint distances from the same executed first-action sequence
secondary_regularization: 1e-4 normalized first action squared residual + 0.002 masked H5 squared position/yaw residual
candidate_constraints: all valid H5 increments must exceed 5cm or 5deg; first action residual <=max(8cm,seed+3cm), yaw <=max(12deg,seed+3deg); masked H5 mean position <=max(8cm,seed+3cm), yaw <=max(6deg,seed+3deg)
codebook_fitting: refine executable first 3 of 15 dimensions; preserve remaining future components; equal source/horizon endpoint loss plus weak center anchor
target_source: GT local first motions, e.g. RVQ targets[:-1,0,:]; offsets count non-STOP motions. Original labels are not needed.
decoding: Three uint16 residual IDs 0..255; sum float32 codebooks[level,id] then wrap each yaw, reshape(5,3). Only complete000 is STOP, decode it to zero. Execution uses first decoded point. Existing float32 decoder and exported float64 wrapping agree within 1e-5.
